overview: This House resolution expresses the House's deep sorrow at the death of Raul M. Grijalva, a Representative from Arizona. It directs the House Clerk to send the resolution to the Senate and a copy to his family. As a further mark of respect, it adjourns the House in his memory at the end of that day. The House adopted it on March 24, 2025.
for: Supporters say it is a customary and fitting way for the House to honor a member who died while serving.
against: Critics say it is a symbolic gesture that does not change any law or spending.
